_comment: The one place that says which model does which kind of work. Copy to policy.json and replace every REPLACE_ value; a policy that still contains one is refused. Model ids are written exactly as the caller needs them (OpenClaw 'provider/model' refs for agent work; the decision endpoint's own id for decision classes).

job_turn.description: Scheduled agent turns. Every job names this class; none inherits a session default.

local_small.description: Small bounded tasks on the local tier; falls back to a cloud model when that machine is asleep.

decision.description: Typed decisions (choice, score, yes/no) on the decision endpoint.

kg_curation.description: The knowledge graph curator's decisions (6-hourly command job).
